placement.bodyCenter: P = project(nativeToSource, simulation ball.pos); no additional position offset or radius change
placement.sourceRadiusPx: R = nativeRadius / (H[2][0]*x + H[2][1]*y + H[2][2]); this H has H00=1, H10=0
placement.bodyScale: uniform scale R / body.contentRadiusPx[0], pivot body.centerLocalPx; keep the generated circular sprite
placement.shadowContentHalfSizeSourcePx: [1.55*R, 0.58*R]; scale content bounds, not transparent canvas
placement.shadowLayer: ground, once, before bodies/ball; existing foreground alpha occludes it
placement.depth: same simulation ball.pos.y as diagnostic; no physics or PRNG effects
placement.inverseView: form source-space actor quad with these rules, transform its vertices by P1 sourceToNative; do not treat raster sphere as a floor circle
